children: has appointed Joaquin Gutierrez as its chief executive, a long awaited decision by markets, Blu Radio reported on Thursday.
Gutierrez will replace Ricardo Roa, who stepped down in late July amid an investigation into alleged campaign spending violations during the 2022 presidential election.
Gutierrez previously served as campaign manager for President Abelardo De La Espriella.

De La Espriella has scheduled an event for Friday in the northern coastal city of Santa Marta titled the "Ecopetrol Rebirth Ceremony," where he is expected to formally present Gutierrez as the new CEO, local media reported.
